title: Neutrino Types
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the number of known neutrino types as two, including their antiparticles.

title: Neutrino Spin
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state that the spin of a neutrino is 1/2.

title: Lepton Number Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that lepton number is conserved in neutrino scattering processes.

title: Difference Neutrino vs Antineutrino
description: Important Criteria: The student must clarify that neutrinos and antineutrinos have opposite lepton numbers.

title: Missing Particle
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the missing particle in the reaction as nu_e.

title: Magnetic Moment
description: Important Criteria: The student must state that if neutrino mass is zero, it has no magnetic moment.

title: Spin Direction
description: Important Criteria: The student should describe the spin direction of neutrinos and antineutrinos correctly.

title: Velocity Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct velocity of the neutrino as 2.6 x 10^7 m/s.

title: Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors in calculations, such as incorrect application of the kinetic energy formula.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
